verdict.rationale: Netlify covers version, review and roll back at the deploy level. Every push auto-deploys, every PR gets a Deploy Preview for review, and any deploy can be rolled back in one click. Community users confirm the PR preview and automated deploy flow. However, nothing in the evidence ties this lifecycle specifically to automations (functions, scheduled jobs, AI-agent workflows). It is only implied, because serverless functions ship inside deploys. Missing for 10: explicit versioning, review and rollback of automations or functions as distinct objects, audit history of automation changes, and independent corroboration of rollback behavior.
